title: Man behind the Knicks' championship ring on capturing New York's grit and energy in design
summary: Designer Jason Arasheben, who's made a name for himself designing professional leagues' championship rings, gives "CBS Mornings" the first up-close look at the Knicks' ring.
contentText: Luxury jeweler Jason Arasheben, known as "Jason of Beverly Hills," has made a name for himself designing for the stars and across professional leagues. He gives "CBS Mornings" the first up-close look at his one-of-a-kind design for the New York Knicks championship ring.
